name: Pond Keep
coords: x east, y up, z south (north is -z), meters, the core at the origin. rotY: three.js yaw, rotY 0 means the prop front (+Z in its GLB) faces +z (south). y is the prop origin height, already on the terrain.
propsSource: apps/client/public/models/props/<prop>.glb (LOD0..LOD2 child nodes), colliders in colliders.json, LOD distances in manifest.json

terrain.heightsEncoding: 16-byte header <4sHHhhHH: 'QWHF', version 1, samples per side 201, origin x -200, origin z -200, cell size 200 cm, 100 units per meter; then 201 x 201 int16 little endian centimeters, row-major, row along z (north to south), col along x (west to east)
terrain.groundEncoding: 16-byte header <4sHHhhHH: 'QWGP', version 1, samples per side 201, origin x, origin z, cell size cm, legend length; then 201 x 201 uint8, same order as the heights

chunks.id: one chunk (the map is small): chunk = 0

water.note: the moat: the terrain is under the water surface (0.0 m) only in the moat (bed -2.4 m); reeds on both banks (moat_reeds, fence colliders) keep ducks out of it; the drawbridge and the raft lanes cross it

zonesNote: callout areas for the HUD and the kill feed, first match wins (the castle parts come first, Pond Meadow last)

playArea.note: center line of the outer hedgerow ring (closed polygon, about 300 m across). The hedges cannot be crossed; the play area is the polygon shrunk by `inset` m. Everything outside is scenery.

dmSpawnsNote: fallback spawns for modes that read dmSpawns: the raid's duck spawns (courtyard and wall walks)

raid.note: Hunt Season markup (docs/pond-keep.md). Positions are map coordinates, y is the feet (or the base) height; every yaw is the player yaw (0 looks north, a duck looks along (-sin yaw, -cos yaw)); a prop's rotY = yaw + PI. props: animated GLBs to place in code (never in `props`).
